name: Aida
note: The world's manifest (docs/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by tools/sync.sh.

rules.note: Aida, MU's map 33, entered from Noria's north-east door: its spawn gate 119, 82,8 to 87,14, the small safe hall in the north-west (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:265; docs/aida-port.md), where a death and the Town Portal land too. Not 0.75's: MU added it in 2005 (Season 1). MU draws it on its black clear with no leaves, birds or weather (GMAida.cpp, SceneManager.cpp:371-402), so for now it takes the underground's air.

air.note: SOUND_AIDA_AMBIENT, aida_ambi.wav, which MoveAidaObject keeps playing from every object every frame (GMAida.cpp:92): always on, the whole map, under open forest sky (MU draws it on its black clear).

indoors.note: Open forest: the first cut held every tile indoors ('underground air'), which kept the butterflies on the ground (flight is held indoors for anything but a bat). MU draws Aida on its black clear with no sky, and its air (world_aida) plays everywhere anyway.

waterfall_spray.note: Its falls' drops, spray and mist (game/world/waterfall_spray.h).

music.note: MUSIC_BC_ADIA, which MU plays the whole time in Aida (SceneManager.cpp:1089-1094); here in the safe hall only, the house rule (the user, 2026-10-11: 'we play music on safezones only').

boids.note: Ours: MU throws MODEL_BUTTERFLY01 off 20 hidden Object61 boxes, one in 25 frames each (type 60, GMAida.cpp:195-204); here Noria's butterfly pool on Noria's numbers flies round the hero instead. MODEL_BUTTERFLY01 (MapManager.cpp:89; GOBoid.cpp:1335: Velocity 0.3, LightEnable false, Light 1). 6.25: the cook's 0.25 s keys over MU's 0.04 s.

crawls.note: MoveFishs' scarabs, MODEL_BUG01 + 1, Tarkan's numbers (GOBoid.cpp:1726-1733); Aida is not exempt from the 3-slot cap (:1668-1675), so 3; drawn at Tarkan's 0.55.

small_fires.note: Object68's small fires on rocks and ruins (type 67, GMAida.cpp:239-242; game/world/small_fires.h).

skull_ghosts.note: Object71's skull ghosts, MODEL_GHOST out of the five hidden skulls (type 70, GMAida.cpp:243-252; game/world/skull_ghosts.h). MuMain loads no model for it in Aida, so only its trail shows; ours adds a soft blurred head.

weather.note: Ours: MU has no weather in Aida. Noria's rain (the user, 2026-10-11: 'we will use also rain for aida how it was on noria'), its light sheets/worlds/aida_rain.json. And a bed in the dry spells, as Noria's jungle plays, under Aida's own air, aida_ambi: first Noria's jungle ('lets use noria forest sound also'), then crickets and bugs at night ('not noria jungle').

leaf_field.note: Ours (the user, 2026-10-11: 'we need leaves when its not raining'): they did fall in every dry spell, but the game's 80 specks were lost on Aida's dark moss; 120, a little over the speck (twice it was 'to large'; the pool's whole 180 'little bit to much').

exits.note: Aida, from Noria, with no direction (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:267).

enters.note: Aida's way back to Noria (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:535). MU asks 10; ours free, the way out as every other map's (the user, 2026-10-11).

spawn.note: OpenMU's spawn gate 119: the box a new character starts in and a dead one stands up in, the .mur's safe gate (pipeline/index.py gate_rows). rules.arrive is its middle. Out of mu.db's gates table in sprint D6.

hidden.note: Aida's nine (MoveAidaObject, GMAida.cpp:77-86; 60 in RenderAidaObjectVisual :195-204): 56, 57 and 58 the waterfall spray boxes, 84 of them; 59, 62 and 63 the mist boxes, 91, which never emit in MU (their emitter is gated on the HiddenMesh the move sets first, :184-226); 60 the butterflies, 20; 67 the small fires, 11; 70 the skull ghost, 5. All emitters, drawn by no mesh. docs/aida-port.md.

grass.note: Aida ships TileGrass01.OZT, dark olive blades, which MU grows on slot 0 (ZzzLodTerrain.cpp:2077-2120), 14 473 drawn tiles; TileGrass02.OZT is fully transparent, so slot 1 grows nothing. docs/aida-port.md.

void.note: Aida: Devias's way, as Tarkan. A NoGround ravine from the entrance to the north-east, walled by Object18-20's 13 m rock faces sunk about 4.7 m, with 40 waterfalls falling into it. Deeper than Tarkan's because the walls and falls reach 4.7-6 m down. And `blend`: where no wall or rock stands on a lip, MU leaves the tile edge as a jagged cut against the black (the user, 2026-10-11: 'there still was some black holes', then 'Soft fade on bare inner edges'), so the ground goes dark into the void over a tile and a half. Only the ground's own shader reads it (abyssEdge, fs_ground), so the walls and rocks on the lips keep their light. No `rim`, which slopes the lips and would hide the walls. docs/aida-port.md, Part B 5.

void_fill.note: Aida, from the safe hall: 177 open tiles in seven crumbs on rows 253-255 that no walk reaches, beyond the walls. docs/aida-port.md.

airs_from.note: MuMain loads MODEL_BUTTERFLY01 from Data/Object1, Lorencia's objects (MapManager.cpp:89), as for Noria.

crawls_from.note: The scarab, MODEL_BUG01 + 1, is built in Tarkan (Object9's Bug02).

grounded_types.note: Ours: the flower beds Object27, 28 and 30, flat cards of flower heads with no stems, which MU stores 0.85-2 m over the ground (median 1.1 m). Over MU's bare ground that passed; in our grass they hung in the air (the user, 2026-10-11: 'those flowers is flaoting in air without any base'). Laid on the terrain and lifted (below).

lifted.note: Ours: the flower beds' heads 0.3 m over the terrain, among the tips of Aida's 0.45 m grass, so they read as flowers on stems the grass hides.

anchor_kinds.note: Aida's waterfall spray boxes (RenderAidaObjectVisual types 56-58, GMAida.cpp:166-183), drawn by game/world/waterfall_spray.h: 18 the falling drops of Object57, 19 the specks bursting off Object58, 20 the mist of Object59. None lights; each carries the box's Scale, which MU adds to every particle's (SPRAY_KINDS). and Object68's small fires on rocks and ruins (type 67, GMAida.cpp:239-242), game/world/small_fires.h, and Object71's skull ghosts (type 70, :243-252), game/world/skull_ghosts.h.
